['EvoBus GmbH '].company_description: Daimler Buses GmbH, formerly EvoBus GmbH, is a German bus and coach manufacturer headquartered in Leinfelden-Echterdingen, Germany and a wholly owned subsidiary of Daimler Truck AG. Its products go to market under the brands Mercedes-Benz and Setra.

['Messer SE & Co. KGaA '].company_description: Messer SE & Co. KGaA operates in Asia, Central and South-Eastern Europe, and Germany. It supplies medical and pharmaceutical gases, turnkey solutions, and vital products, particularly in pandemic situations. The company has a proven track record as a reliable provider of these products. Messer SE & Co. KGaA posted sales of 4.16 billion euros and an EBITDA of 1.17 billion euros in the past financial year. It is headquartered in Bad Soden, near Frankfurt, Germany, and has experience with the European Commission Directorate-General for International Partnerships.
